verdict.rationale: First-party docs show self-serve forwarding: with a few taps from the phone app or web portal, users can forward letters or packages to a different address, domestically or internationally, without contacting support. Nothing documents the rest of the story. 'Adding an Additional Recipient' (docs-29) covers who can receive mail at the mailbox, not saved forwarding destinations, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: rule-based or automatic forwarding, saved forwarding addresses, carrier/shipping-speed selection, cost shown before confirming, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
